title: 用腿站高一点
description: 成人低墙大脚点上小幅伸膝站起，双手只是稳定支撑。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult rises a little by extending the supporting knee on a broad low foothold, hands staying on large grips for balance rather than hauling the body upward. The other foot remains secure on a neighboring large step. Capture a modest height change with hips above the foot and shoulders quiet. Show the complete body in profile against a sparse low wall, with the mat and immediate descent option clearly visible. Use transparent watercolor with reserved paper light, fluid contours, a restrained indigo and warm sienna palette, and generous breathing room. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
